To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• We demonstrate the feasibility and robustness of deep learning approaches for medical imaging using non-medical training data.
• We demonstrate that a deep learning model can be used to classify chest x-ray pathologies.

1) Deep learning based approaches using non-medical image data are effective for chest pathology classification; and 2) Deep learning based feature extraction is effective for pathology classification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: • What is the most informative feature for the pathology classification problem?
the development of an automatic system for detecting chest pathology in x-ray images.
developing a framework to identify chest x-ray pathology using deep learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
deep learning with nonmedical training is an excellent starting point and a promising direction for medical image analysis, especially for tasks with limited training data.
deep learning is a very promising approach for medical image recognition, and that it is a good candidate for a first step in the direction of automatic medical image analysis.
the deep features learned by a CNN are very informative for the task of pathology identification in chest radiographs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the features learned by CNN are robust to domain shift, and can be used to detect pathology in chest x-ray images.
the features extracted from the deep layers of CNNs can provide better results for the pathology classification than the classical features.
we are able to detect chest pathology using deep learning approaches with non-medical data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep features extracted from CNNs can be used to identify pathology in chest x-ray images with high accuracy, without any medical training data.
the features learned from a large scale non-medical dataset can be used for medical imaging tasks with high accuracy.
the deep learning features can be used as an alternative to handcrafted features for the medical image analysis tasks.
